verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Mastra Knowledge as a scoped, editable page graph that agents can read and write. It mentions that pinned context depends on Memory, but nothing documents summaries of past sessions or threads for resuming a conversation. Agents writing findings to shared pages is a related but different feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off
